All order and catalogue operations are passed on to the injected application services: OrderService.place, listByStatus, advance and cancel, and CatalogueService.create and listStock. The only checks it does are request parsing. isOrderStatus confirms that an incoming string is one of the enum values, and singleValue confirms that a route parameter is a single string. These are adapter-level parsing checks, not business rules. Rules about which status changes are allowed, cancelling, or stock are left to the application and domain layers.
